# ankra_ovh_cluster_settings (Resource)

Day-2 settings of an OVHcloud cluster Ankra provisions (`ankra cluster ovh gateway-model`): the model of its managed gateway. The plan warns before the model is sent. The platform cannot read the model back, so `gateway_model` keeps the configured value, and the first apply after an import records it without sending it. Destroy leaves the gateway as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ovh_cluster_settings" "prod" {
  cluster_id    = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
  gateway_model = "m"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `gateway_model` (String) Model of the managed gateway: `s`, `m`, `l`, `xl`, `2xl` or `3xl`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by cluster id. The first apply writes the configured model.
terraform import ankra_ovh_cluster_settings.prod 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666
```
